verdict: Yes. Taashacraft from Kosamba in Gujarat pitched handcrafted jewellery and bangles on Shark Tank India Season 5 and got a deal. Bangles are a staple of Indian weddings and festivals, and customised or handpainted bangles sell at good prices.
angle: Bridal and festive bangle sets, personalised with names or dates, are popular for weddings and gifting. Hyderabad, Firozabad and Jaipur are known bangle clusters. Customisation creates loyalty but needs a fast production team.
